note: Added 2026-09-09 together with 13 sibling Greater Vancouver property tax notices, on request, to grow `propertytax` coverage from 6 documents to 20. The DISTRICT of North Vancouver (3003 SUNNYHURST RD), a different municipality from the two CITY of North Vancouver notices. total_invoice_amount is the COLUMN A (no home owner grant) figure -- the amount payable when no grant is claimed, which is the column the pipeline chose on all 14 new notices. A=875.60 / B=305.60 / C=30.60. The prepayment and credit lines (-4,854.70, and -65.62 interest earned on prepayments) are deductions within THIS year's charges rather than a balance carried forward, so the NET AMOUNT DUE is the right figure. account_number comes from the explicitly printed 'ACCOUNT NUMBER 100198790007' on the remittance stub. || invoice_date is NOT asserted: this notice prints no issue-date label, so build_write_values substitutes date.today() and the scaffold captured the run date (2026-09-09) -- a false green that would flip red tomorrow. Same reason as property_surrey. || invoice_description NOT asserted: free-text that rewords itself every run. || The narrative fields (diagnosis_solution, recommendation, warranty and their zh_hant twins) are blank by policy on a municipal bill. || folio_number ADDED 2026-09-09 with the new folio twins (commercial-narrative-v20). It is a critical field on property tax notices only (field_policy.PROPERTYTAX_DELTA), and is asserted on every sidecar -- the value on a tax notice, "" everywhere else -- so a regression that starts populating it on ordinary invoices is caught. || account_number RE-BASELINED 2026-09-09 to the FOLIO (user decision): when a property tax notice prints BOTH a folio number and an account number, the folio is the one kept. This notice is one of only two in the corpus where the two genuinely differ -- on the other 18 the fields already held the same string. The displaced value was 'Account No: 100198790007', recorded here so the change is reversible. Scoped to municipal + propertytax in field_policy.propertytax_account_from_folio. NOTE the displaced value is the one this notice prints under its OWN account label; on property_north_van_district that is the number the stub gives for ONLINE BANKING. See DV-11 before anything downstream pays or reconciles from this column. || billing_period_start_date AND billing_period_end_date ASSERTIONS REMOVED 2026-09-09 (user authorised, all 20 propertytax sidecars): the Power Automate flow does not consume the billing period for property tax, so the corpus no longer asserts it on this family. Both fields REMAIN in WRITE_FIELDS and still reach Dynamics -- removing the assertion stops the corpus checking them, it does not stop them being written. What this gives up, stated once: on the 16 notices that asserted '' the pair was the guard against a generate twin inventing a period out of nothing, and on property_surrey it was catching a real failure chain -- B3's invented number_of_days=1 makes the code derive start = end - 1 day, which collapses the period to zero length and blanks a correct 2026-01-01 (open-defects A13b, measured 4 of 6 reads correct). That chain is unfixed and is now invisible to the corpus on every property tax notice.
